verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is a SaaS app builder, so a public API with UI parity is a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no public API. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The GitHub/MCP connectors and the AI's control of the dev environment are features Bolt uses internally or as a client. They are not an API that lets users run UI actions programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
